docTitle.zh: Wrisp — 今天，你需要一个创作助手
docTitle.en: Wrisp — Today, you need a creation assistant

docDesc.zh: 使用自然语言记录，自动整理成信息卡片、待办与周报；写作时随时调用。
docDesc.en: Use natural language to record. Wrisp files your notes into information cards, todos and weekly reports, then hands them back while you write.

jsonldDesc.zh: 本地优先的智能创作助手：语音与文字记录、自动整理、检索问答、创作空间。数据默认不出本机。
jsonldDesc.en: A local-first writing assistant: voice and text capture, automatic organizing, retrieval with sources, and a writing space. Local by default.

jsonldOfferDesc.zh: Community 免费，AI 走你自己的 Key，不代扣模型费用。
jsonldOfferDesc.en: Community is free. AI model runs on your own key; we never bill model costs on your behalf.
